code_prefixes.description: Folders (with trailing slash) whose changes count as code and require a context delta.

ignored_names.description: File names that never count as code, e.g. placeholders.

test_prefixes.description: Folders that hold tests. They count as code but are never mutated.

mutation_critical_paths.description: Folders where mutation testing is mandatory (money, security, concurrency, public contracts).

mutation_min_score.description: Minimum mutation score, in percent, for the mandatory files.

stale_days.description: A task in progress with no commit or CI run for longer turns yellow.

lastcontext_size.description: Recently merged tasks shown per role.

chart_days.description: Days shown in the tasks-merged-per-day chart.

next_size.description: Pending tasks listed under 'Next, in order'.

knowledge_budget.description: Active ADRs and gotchas above which a review is due.

role_tags.description: Role name -> list of tags; filters the per-role last-context.
